gaps.description: RESOLVED (T04-05). No v1 golden parser fixtures per language existed. O4 was closed by ADR-0001; per-language tree-sitter goldens were then authored for the full v0 set — TypeScript (T04-03), JavaScript (T04-04), Rust (T04-05) — in parser/index.json (ADR-0002). Config/text universal-kind fixtures (config_section|text_section) belong to the later universal path (groups 05/08), not to this O4 gap.
Only skip-policy is present in v1. No full generation diff fixtures (tree A -> tree B -> expected files/occurrences added/removed/renamed + skips).
The 49-query corpus is single-relevant (one ground-truth target per query); no graded relevance judgments / multiple relevant docs. v2 gate thresholds (MRR regression budget, Recall@5) are TBD.

RESOLVED (T14-07). The rev6 labeled observation-stream corpus (transcript -> expected ops, covering decision vs hypothesis vs negation, RU/EN mixed and RU/EN code-switched) did not exist in v1. It now does: 42 `memory.router.op.*` cases in memory/index.json, scored by `cargo xtask memory-bench` (crates/xtask/src/memory_bench/) against local_rag_memory::router::route. The P/R gate thresholds themselves remain a separate open item -- see baseline.thresholds.memory_router_precision_p/memory_router_recall_r below, set only after a real baseline run (O2).

RESOLVED (T14-08, T16-04). Prompt-injection round-trip-inert, delimiter-collision escaping and recall per-entry/per-block caps (14 §6, 12 §4) are v2-spec requirements absent in v1. T14-08 closed the formatter-level slice -- `additionalContext` sanitization/escaping/1KiB-caps/exact-len/empty-output -- with real unit tests in `crates/memory/src/recall/format.rs` and 5 documented `adversarial.recall.*` cases in adversarial/index.json. T16-04 closed the remaining end-to-end slice -- a memory stored through the real `remember` op engine, recalled through the real wired daemon/MCP `recall` tool, verified inert (`adversarial.recall.end-to-end-*`), plus the card's adjacent adversarial/ownership corpus: malicious indexed code round-tripping via plain JSON encoding (`adversarial.code.*`), source secrets and symlink escapes through the real scan/reconcile/build pipeline (`adversarial.index.*`), and hook-captured secrets never touching disk (`adversarial.hook.*`).

RESOLVED (T00-03, T07-05, T13-06; closed at gate G13 after D-019). Executable failpoint/kill-point scripts for the F1-F12 projection matrix (05 §10) and S1-S8 spool matrix (07 §7) were not present in v1 (v1 has no crash/kill/torn-write tests). The harness mechanism landed in T00-03; the F1-F12 projection matrix is fully executable (crates/projection/tests/fault_matrix.rs + fault_matrix_coverage.rs's mechanically-checked cross-reference against matrix.json, plus the pre-existing switch_faults.rs/rebuild_faults.rs/rebuild.rs tests for F1/F11/F12). S1-S8 (spool kill matrix, 07 §7) shipped in T13-06: crates/local-rag-hook/tests/kill_matrix.rs (S1/S2) and crates/store/tests/spool_kill_matrix.rs (S3-S8), all real SIGABRT-subprocess/failpoint tests, gated PASS at G13 (after D-019, an unrelated redaction-version propagation gap the same gate found and fixed).
gaps.resolves_in: T00-03 (harness, done), T07-05 (F1-F12, done), T13-06 (S1-S8, done, gated PASS after D-019 at G13)
